featured_reviews.name: Anjali Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Most customer unfriendly organisation. Absolutely non professional #viratkohli

Go Digit's customer feedback process deserves a rating of its own. 😄
After a WhatsApp support interaction, I was repeatedly asked for feedback. The choices offered? 5 (Excellent) and 4 (Very Good). Looking for anything below that? Good luck.
There was an "Other" option, but it did not allow me to submit an alternative rating.
A feedback system that only accepts positive ratings isn't really measuring customer satisfaction—it's measuring how well the survey is designed to collect favorable scores.
Genuine customer-centricity means being willing to hear what customers didn't like, not just what they did.
When feedback mechanisms filter out criticism, the data may look great, but the customer experience doesn't necessarily improve. 😉
